trait.name: Arcane Armament
entries: The war-artificer's weapon attacks are magical. It uses Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for their attack and damage rolls.

trait.name: Siege Engineer
entries: The war-artificer has advantage on ability checks made to operate, disable, or repair constructs and magical devices.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The war-artificer makes three attacks, using Arc Carbine or Voltaic Maul in any combination.

action.name: Arc Carbine
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) lightning damage.

action.name: Voltaic Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Storm-Coil Grenade (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The war-artificer throws a device at a point it can see within 90 feet. Each creature of its choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered there must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 7d8}) lightning damage and is pulled up to 10 feet toward the center. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pulled. The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures until the start of the war-artificer's next turn.

action.name: Emergency Overhaul (2/Day)
entries: The war-artificer touches a construct or magical device and restores 30 hit points to it. Alternatively, it reactivates one disabled airship battery, ward node, or similar device within reach. A device reactivated this way can't be reactivated by this feature again until the next dawn.

bonus.name: Repulsor Step
entries: The war-artificer flies up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and it must end this movement on a surface capable of supporting it.

reaction.name: Flash Ward
entries: When the war-artificer or an allied creature it can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the war-artificer adds 4 to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

legendary.name: Reposition
entries: The war-artificer moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Arc Carbine (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The war-artificer makes one Arc Carbine attack.
